title: publish-v1 shared definitions
description: Definitions the other publish-v1 schemas $ref by relative file name. Not a message of its own. Resolve locally; never fetch over the network.

slug.description: A tournament's public handle. The operator token publishes to any slug it likes; an installation key only to one minted for it by POST /api/tournaments.

resultToken.description: A game result as OpenPairings stores it, verbatim. 1-0/0-1/1/2-1/2 ordinary; ...U played but unrated; 1/2-0 and 0-1/2 the asymmetric results; 0-0 played, both nothing; ...FF forfeits (FIDE Art. 16). The legacy +-- and --+ are normalised to 1-0FF / 0-1FF by the publisher and never cross.

errorCode.description: Every `error` value an API route of this contract can answer with. Clients dispatch on this, never on `detail` or the status alone. Most come from OpenResultsWeb.ApiError; not_an_object, wrong_schema, unknown_version, missing_slug and invalid come from the snapshot ingest, history_requires_auth / bad_at / not_found from the read routes.

errorExtras.description: Fields some error codes add beside `error` and `detail`.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (rate_limited, storage_low). Also sent as the Retry-After header.

limit.description: The cap that was hit: tournaments per installation (tournament_limit) or live games per tournament (live_game_limit).

limit_bytes.description: snapshot_too_large: the most an installation key may publish, in bytes.

ply.description: invalid_moves: the 1-based ply (half-move) of the first illegal or ambiguous move.
